query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pubchem_cid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pubchem_enriched,
  SUM(CASE WHEN chebi_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as chebi_enriched,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pubchem_cid IS NULL AND chebi_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unenriched
FROM molecules;
